prompt: Is this a simple sentence or a compound sentence?
promptSpeech: Is this a simple sentence or a compound sentence: I watched a scary movie.
hint: A compound sentence joins two complete thoughts with , and / , but / , so; a simple sentence has only one complete thought.
explanation: "I watched a scary movie." expresses one single complete thought, so it is a simple sentence.
